reviews.review:
I hate to review this after only 24 minutes, but I wanna make it clear that I very much enjoyed the singleplayer variant of Ocean Keeper, so naturally I was excited to play this with a friend to try out the co-op version of it. 

The co-op version plays NOTHING like the singleplayer version at all. Firstly, your spider is entirely immobile during waves, which means the kiting strategy in singleplayer is nonexistent, and you're at the mercy of RNG for your weapons to do any remote damage. 

I will mention the game does explicitly tell you that the game is better played with 4 players, and no less. Here's the killing point for the game: There is no adjustment in difficulty for less than 4 players.; Not 2, not 3, just 4 player difficulty constantly. This is what kills the game for me because I'm not always going to have 3 other friends available at a time to play it, which means there's no reason to play the game at all if you have less than 4 players available. 

The reason I write this review is because I got suckered in by all the positive reviews suggesting how much fun the game is; I'm sad to say it isn't because the developers locked the difficulty at 4 players only with no forgiveness of less than. If the difficulty gets adjusted based on number of players in the future, I'll edit my review. Till then, it's a pass for me.
